- Trip condition (any):

  2) runRequest AND NOT pressureValid (data invalid worst-case).
  Trip and cause same scan effective.
- tripLatched self-holding. Clear: resetBtn rising edge AND NOT runRequest AND pressureValid AND pressure <= 4200.0. Hysteresis 300.
- currentCauseMask low 4 bits, recalculated each scan:
  bit0=1 sensor failure: runRequest AND NOT pressureValid.
  bit1=2 valve stuck: outletCmd>=50 AND outletFeedback<=10 continuously for 3 execution cycles or more.
  bit2=4 combustion excess: fuelFlow >=4.0 AND steamFlow <=10.0 inclusive.
  bit1/bit2 only evaluated under overpressure condition: runRequest AND pressureValid AND pressure>=4500.0. If overpressure but none of those, set bit3=8 (unlocated).
  NOT runRequest -> mask 0.

Implementation:
```
tmp_resetRising := resetBtn AND NOT lastResetBtn;
lastResetBtn := resetBtn;

tmp_overpressure := runRequest AND pressureValid AND pressure >= 4500.0;
tmp_invalid := runRequest AND NOT pressureValid;
tmp_tripCondition := tmp_overpressure OR tmp_invalid;
tmp_legalReset := tmp_resetRising AND NOT runRequest AND pressureValid AND pressure <= 4200.0;

IF NOT runRequest THEN
    currentCauseMask := WORD#0;
    stuckCounter := 0;
ELSIF NOT pressureValid THEN
    currentCauseMask := WORD#1;
    stuckCounter := 0;
ELSIF pressure >= 4500.0 THEN
    tmp_stuckCond := (outletCmd >= 50) AND (outletFeedback <= 10);
    IF tmp_stuckCond THEN
        stuckCounter := stuckCounter + 1;
    ELSE
        stuckCounter := 0;
    END_IF;
    tmp_stuckBit := stuckCounter >= 3;
    tmp_excessBit := (fuelFlow >= 4.0) AND (steamFlow <= 10.0);
    IF tmp_stuckBit AND tmp_excessBit THEN
        currentCauseMask := WORD#6;
    ELSIF tmp_excessBit THEN
        currentCauseMask := WORD#4;
    ELSIF tmp_stuckBit THEN
        currentCauseMask := WORD#2;
    ELSE
        currentCauseMask := WORD#8;
    END_IF;
ELSE
```
